stem: Why did Dr. Hunter have hope that the yellow-spotted bell frog might someday be rediscovered?

options.label: F
options.text: The decrease in predators made it likely that some frogs survived.

options.label: G
options.text: Other species thought to be extinct had been found.

options.label: H
options.text: Conditions where the frogs were typically found became less dangerous.

options.label: J
options.text: Less human contact reduced the risk to the species.
